title: Support variable-radius fillets

body:
Source: user report from an LLM agent rebuilding Mouse Thumb from a 3D scan. Original report item 3; high user-reported impact.

Current gap: Failures currently return generic Failed to fillet / Failed to chamfer messages. Native exception guards exist, but users cannot distinguish impossible geometry from an excessive radius or tangency problem.

Code evidence: [cpp/src/factory.cpp:2091](https://github.com/Lenny32/spicy3d/blob/1fab0f9be188dd243cd2a5bf6d996cc32094ccce/cpp/src/factory.cpp#L2091). Audited on develop at 1fab0f9 (2026-09-30).

Acceptance criteria: Surface available OCCT diagnostics; identify radius and tangent-face failures when determinable, without claiming unsupported certainty.

Validation: static code audit; the original scan-specific failure was not reproduced. The audit's 83 passing targeted tests verify existing expressions, loft/thicken, B-splines and kernel guards, not this missing task.

Save-format constraint: saved document formats are frozen; preserve existing payloads. Any required format change must receive explicit prior boss approval.

title: Report actionable fillet and chamfer failure diagnostics

body:
Source: user report from an LLM agent rebuilding Mouse Thumb from a 3D scan. Original report item 3; high user-reported impact.

Current gap: Tracked and untracked fillet/chamfer paths accept IsDone() without a BRepCheck_Analyzer validity check. The user reported an invalid perimeter fillet on free-form geometry; that scan-specific result has not been reproduced on this build.

Code evidence: [cpp/src/factory.cpp:2089](https://github.com/Lenny32/spicy3d/blob/1fab0f9be188dd243cd2a5bf6d996cc32094ccce/cpp/src/factory.cpp#L2089). Audited on develop at 1fab0f9 (2026-09-30).

Acceptance criteria: Validate tracked and untracked results before accepting them; return Result errors for invalid shapes. Add a free-form regression showing later booleans remain safe.

Validation: static code audit; the original scan-specific failure was not reproduced. The audit's 83 passing targeted tests verify existing expressions, loft/thicken, B-splines and kernel guards, not this missing task.
